newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: MALAYSIA MINING REVISES SHARE PURCHASE.
newsitem.headline: MALAYSIA MINING REVISES SHARE PURCHASE.

text.p: Malaysia Mining Corp Bhd (MMC) said on Monday it had revised the terms of its proposed acquisition of a stake in Berjuntai Tin Dredging Bhd.
Engineering services firm MMC said its acquisition of 28.86 million new shares in Berjuntai for 129.88 million ringgit would be revised to 22.68 million new shares for 102.07 million ringgit.
The share acquisition would then trigger a mandatory general offer for the remaining 59.68 percent of Berjuntai it does not own, at an offer price of 4.50 ringgit per Berjuntai share.
Berjuntai had announced in April that it planned to acquire the entire equity in cement and clinker companies Kesabah Holdings Sdn Bhd and Batuluga Sdn Bhd for 179.08 million ringgit.

MMC said on Monday that Berjuntai had revised the total price consideration to 180.2 million ringgit, and the term of payment has been revised from the issue of 59.69 million shares to the issue of 51.57 million shares of MMC at 3.00 ringgit each, and 25.50 million ringgit in cash.
